build_deepinfra_rerank_url: build the complete DeepInfra inference endpoint URL for a rerank model
validate_deepinfra_environment: validate the DeepInfra environment by checking for an API key and returning configured headers
map_cohere_rerank_params: map Cohere rerank parameters to DeepInfra format with queries and documents arrays
transform_deepinfra_response: transform a DeepInfra rerank API response into a standardized RerankResponse object
extract_deepinfra_error: extract error details from a DeepInfra API error response and raise a BaseLLMException
